cards.ex: She holds the view that climate change is the biggest threat we face.
cards.exUz: U iqlim o'zgarishi biz duch kelayotgan eng katta xavf, degan fikrda.
cards.uzDef: Biror fikrni qat'iy qo'llab-quvvatlash, undan qaytmaslik.

cards.ex: I've come to believe that honesty is always the best policy.
cards.exUz: Men halollik har doim eng yaxshi siyosat ekanligiga ishonch hosil qildim.
cards.uzDef: Vaqt o'tishi bilan bir narsaga ishonishni boshlash.

cards.ex: I honestly believe that she's the right person for the job.
cards.exUz: Men chin dildan uning bu lavozimga loyiq ekanligiga ishonaman.
cards.uzDef: Rostdan, samimiy ishonmoq.

cards.ex: It's my conviction that education is key to a better future.
cards.exUz: Ta'lim yaxshi kelajakning kaliti, bu mening e'tiqodim.
cards.uzDef: Bu mening qat'iy ishonchim, fikrim.

cards.ex: I have reason to suspect he's not being entirely truthful.
cards.exUz: Menda uning to'liq rost gapirmayotganiga shubha qilishga asos bor.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir noto'g'ri deb hisoblash uchun sabab bor.

cards.ex: In my book, kindness is the most important quality.
cards.exUz: Mening fikrimcha, mehribonlik eng muhim fazilatdir.
cards.uzDef: Mening fikrimga ko'ra, shaxsiy fikrimcha.

cards.ex: There's a widespread belief that organic food is healthier.
cards.exUz: Organik ovqat sog'lomroq degan keng tarqalgan ishonch bor.
cards.uzDef: Ko'pchilik tomonidan qabul qilingan ishonch.

cards.ex: To the best of my belief, everyone followed the instructions.
cards.exUz: Mening ishonchimga ko'ra, hamma ko'rsatmalarga amal qildi.
cards.term: To the best of my belief
cards.uzDef: Menga ma'lum bo'lgan eng yaxshi ma'lumotga asoslanib.

cards.ex: I had a nagging doubt about whether I'd made the right decision.
cards.exUz: Men to'g'ri qaror qildimmi, degan tinchlik bermaydigan shubham bor edi.
cards.uzDef: Doimiy, bezovta qiluvchi shubha.

cards.ex: It's a common misconception that all mushrooms are poisonous.
cards.exUz: Hamma qo'ziqorinlar zaharli degan umumiy xato tushuncha bor.
cards.uzDef: Ko'pchilik adashadigan noto'g'ri tushuncha.

cards.ex: She espoused the cause of animal rights for many years.
cards.exUz: U ko'p yillar davomida hayvonlar huquqlarini himoya qildi.
cards.uzDef: Biror maqsad yoki e'tiqodni faol qo'llab-quvvatlash.

cards.ex: I have serious misgivings about this new policy.
cards.exUz: Menda bu yangi siyosatga nisbatan jiddiy xavotirlar bor.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir to'g'ri emasligiga jiddiy shubhalar, xavotirlar.

cards.ex: It's difficult to change people's entrenched beliefs.
cards.exUz: Odamlarning qat'iy e'tiqodlarini o'zgartirish qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Chuqur ildiz otgan, o'zgartirish qiyin bo'lgan e'tiqodlar.

cards.ex: Against my better judgement, I lent him the money.
cards.exUz: Aqlga zid ravishda, men unga pul berdim.
cards.uzDef: Oqilona bo'lmasa ham, biror narsa qilish.

cards.ex: He showed questionable judgement in hiring his friend.
cards.exUz: U do'stini ishga olishda shubhali hukm ko'rsatdi.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri yoki shubhali qaror qabul qilish qobiliyati.

cards.ex: The boss takes a dim view of employees being late.
cards.exUz: Boshliq xodimlarning kech qolishiga yomon qaraydi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani yoqtirmaslik, unga nisbatan salbiy fikrda bo'lish.

cards.ex: We had a difference of opinion about the best way forward.
cards.exUz: Bizda eng yaxshi yo'l haqida fikrlar farqi bor edi.
cards.uzDef: Turli xil fikrlarga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: They hold their family traditions sacred.
cards.exUz: Ular oilaviy an'analarini muqaddas deb biladilar.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani juda muhim va hurmatga loyiq deb hisoblash.

cards.ex: I don't subscribe to the theory that money buys happiness.
cards.exUz: Men pul baxt keltiradi degan nazariyaga qo'shilmayman.
cards.uzDef: Biror nazariyani to'g'ri deb qabul qilish.

cards.ex: It's all a matter of perspective, really.
cards.exUz: Aslida, barchasi nuqtai nazar masalasidir.
cards.uzDef: Barchasi qanday qarashingizga bog'liq.

cards.ex: The evidence calls into question his version of events.
cards.exUz: Dalillar uning voqealar versiyasini shubha ostiga qo'yadi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning haqiqiyligiga yoki to'g'riligiga shubha bildirish.

cards.ex: He has a deep-seated belief in the power of education.
cards.exUz: U ta'lim kuchiga chuqur ishonadi.
cards.uzDef: Chuqur ildiz otgan va o'zgartirish qiyin bo'lgan ishonch.

cards.ex: Against all reason, she still trusted him.
cards.exUz: Aqlga zid ravishda, u hali ham unga ishondi.
cards.uzDef: Mantiqqa yoki oqilona fikrlashga zid ravishda.

cards.ex: They built the house in defiance of local planning laws.
cards.exUz: Ular uyni mahalliy rejalashtirish qonunlariga qarshi qurishdi.
cards.uzDef: Nimagadir qarshi harakat qilish.

cards.ex: I'm willing to give him the benefit of the doubt.
cards.exUz: Men unga ishonch bildirishga tayyorman.
cards.uzDef: Dalillar yetarli bo'lmasa ham, kimdir haq ekanligiga ishonish.

cards.ex: The prevalent view is that the economy will improve.
cards.exUz: Iqtisodiyot yaxshilanadi degan ustun fikr mavjud.
cards.uzDef: Ko'pchilik odamlar tomonidan qabul qilingan fikr.

cards.ex: We need to question the premise upon which this policy is based.
cards.exUz: Biz ushbu siyosat asoslangan g'oyani so'roq qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror argumentning asosiy g'oyasini yoki asosini shubha ostiga qo'yish.

cards.ex: The issue of pay is a major bone of contention.
cards.exUz: To'lov masalasi asosiy tortishuv sababidir.
cards.uzDef: Munozara yoki kelishmovchilikning sababi.

cards.ex: His actions fly in the face of common sense.
cards.exUz: Uning harakatlari sog'lom fikrga zid.
cards.uzDef: Odatda qabul qilingan narsaga yoki e'tiqodga zid bo'lish.

cards.ex: These are the fundamental tenets of their belief system.
cards.exUz: Bular ularning e'tiqod tizimining asosiy tamoyillaridir.
cards.uzDef: Biror e'tiqod tizimining asosiy tamoyillari yoki e'tiqodlari.
